claim.claim-text: 1. Method for detecting dispersed nanoparticles in a liquid dispersion sample, said method using an electronic data processor for classifying the sample as having, or not having, nanoparticles present,
wherein the method further comprises the steps of:

2. Method according to the previous claim for detecting and identifying nanoparticles in a liquid dispersion sample, further comprising the electronic data processor classifying, if present, the nanoparticle into one of a plurality of nanoparticle type classes by using the machine learning classifier which has been pre-trained using a plurality of nanoparticle liquid dispersion specimen type classes.
3. Device according to according to any of the previous claims, wherein the laser is a visible light laser or an infrared laser, in particular an infrared laser.
4. Method according to the previous claim wherein the split temporal periods are overlapping temporal periods.

5. Method according to any of the previous claims wherein the electronic data processor is further arranged to pre-train and classify using time domain histogram-derived or time domain statistics-derived features from the captured signal, in particular the features: wNakagami
; µNakagami
; entropy; standard deviation; or combinations thereof.

6. Method according to any of the claims previous claims wherein the focusing optical system is a convergent lens, in particular being a polymeric ptotoconcentrator arranged at the tip of an optical fibre or waveguide.

7. Method according to any of the previous claims wherein the calculation of transform coefficients comprises selecting a minimum subset of transform coefficients such that a predetermined percentage of the total energy of the signal is preserved by the transform.
8. Method according to any of the previous claims comprising signal capture of at least a sampling frequency of at least five times the modulation frequency.
9. Method according to any of the previous claims wherein the modulation frequency is equal or above 1kHz.

10. Non-transitory storage media including program instructions for implementing a method for detecting nanoparticles in a liquid dispersion sample, the program instructions including instructions executable by an electronic data processor to carry out the method of any of the previous claims.

11. Device for detecting dispersed nanoparticles in a liquid dispersion sample, said device comprising a laser emitter; a focusing optical system coupled to the emitter; an infrared light receiver; and an electronic data processor arranged to classify the sample as having, or not having, nanoparticles present using a machine learning classifier which has been pre-trained using a plurality of nanoparticle liquid dispersion specimens by a method comprising:
12. Device according to according to claim 11, wherein the laser is an infrared laser.
13. Device according to any of the claims 11-12 wherein the split temporal periods are overlapping temporal periods.

14. Device according to according to any of the previous claims 11-13, wherein the focusing optical system is a convergent lens, in particular wherein the lens has a focusing spot corresponding to a beam waist of 1/3th to 1/4th of a base diameter of the lens.
15. Device according to any of the claims 11-14 wherein the focusing optical system is a focusing optical system suitable to provide a field gradient pattern.
